annotation.emotional_arc: A call to action moving from awakening to a firm commitment to challenge obstacles and realize dreams.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: People who are inactive, unaware, or passive in their lives.
acceptable_visual_variants: A silhouette of a person standing up and looking towards a rising sun
A crowd of people looking up and stepping forward from a dark background
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting people literally asleep in beds would miss the call to action and social awakening.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show people transitioning from a state of rest or shadow into active movement or light, symbolizing awakening.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: People who create, nurture, and plan their future aspirations and hopes.
acceptable_visual_variants: A person sketching or mapping out glowing lines of light in the air
A figure looking at a starry sky where constellations form symbolic shapes of hope
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing people literally weaving threads on a loom would look like a textile craft rather than planning a future.
metaphor_spans.tenor: creating and nurturing hopes or aspirations
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a person looking thoughtfully at a glowing, interconnected web of stars or light patterns, suggesting the creation of ideas.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'सपने बुनने वालों' as 'dreamers' loses the vivid, active metaphor of 'weaving' dreams ('बुनने' from 'बुनना' meaning to weave).
The translation of 'सच कर दिखाना है' as 'must be realized' loses the active, visual sense of 'showing' or 'proving' dreams to be true ('दिखाना' meaning to show/demonstrate).

annotation.theme: The arrival of the moment of resolve, urging people to awaken, shape their destiny, and actively overcome worldly struggles to fulfill their dreams.

original_poem:
संकल्प का समय आया है,
उठो जागो अब सोने वालों!
सपने बुनने वालों की क़िस्मत,
अब है बनने वाली।

दुनिया की सारी कठिनाईयों को,
अब चुनौती देना है।
सपनों को सच कर दिखाना है,
अब यही करना है।
translated_poem:
Time of Resolve  
The time of resolve has arrived,  
Rise, awaken, O sleepers!  
The destiny of dreamers,  
Is now on the verge of being made.

Now is the time to challenge,  
All the struggles of the world.  
Dreams must be realized,  
This is what must be done.
